basic_details.job_title: GMC Baramati Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 51 Professor, Associate & Assistant Professor Posts
basic_details.post_name: Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor (Group B)
basic_details.short_information: Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Government Medical College, Baramati (GMC Baramati), Maharashtra, has invited applications for 51 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. 4140/2026. The posts include Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor (Group B). Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Paid at the Cash Branch of the college against a government receipt. Last date to pay the fee: 25 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Educational qualification, experience and eligibility as per NMC notification dated 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2025; work experience as per NMC standards; research papers and other eligibility as per Medical Council of India standards.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: As per NMC notification dated 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2025. Age limit: Maximum 69 years. Pay: Rs.2,00,000 per month (non-retired candidates). Qualification required: As per NMC notification dated 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2025. Age limit: Maximum 69 years. Pay: Rs.1,00,000 per month (non-retired candidates).

salary_details.pay_scale: Monthly honorarium for non-retired candidates: Professor Rs.2,00,000 , Associate Professor Rs.1,85,000 , Assistant Professor Rs.1,00,000 ; retired teachers as per GR dated 21.08.2024

exam_pattern.details: Candidates must bring original documents for verification during the interview

how_to_apply: Download the application form from www.med-edu.in or www.gmcbaramati.org.
Fill the form correctly and completely.
Attach attested educational, experience and other documents in the order of the attached list.
Submit the application and all documents in duplicate.
Submit in person or by registered post at the college between 16-11-2026 and 25-11-2026, 11.00 to 05.00 pm, excluding government holidays.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Retired teachers appointed on contract get monthly honorarium as per Medical Education and Drugs Department GR No. LEC-2024/PK 181/Vaiseva-3 dated 21.08.2024. Contract until a regular candidate is available or 364 days, whichever is earlier Appointment may be terminated without notice for unsatisfactory work, serious irregularity or misconduct No right to regular appointment; contract period not counted for any service purpose Only casual leave admissible Cannot leave service before end of at least one academic session; affidavit required before appointment Non-retired appointees later regularly appointed get no benefit of earlier service

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Paid at the Cash Branch of the college against a government receipt. Last date to pay the fee: 25 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will GMC Baramati Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Provisional merit list on 85 marks (Annexure-A items 1 to 4) Document verification and interview Minimum 41% of 100 marks required for contract appointment Degree marks (MS/MD/MCh/DNB, MBBS aggregate, XII aggregate): 50 marks Additional qualification (DNB/CPS/PhD/Fellowship): 5 marks Teaching experience in concerned speciality (mandatory): 20 marks Research paper publication (mandatory): 10 marks Interview: 15 marks Minimum 41% of 100 marks required

content_sections.heading: GMC Baramati Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring original documents for verification during the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application form in duplicate Attested educational certificates Attested experience certificates Other attested documents in the order of the attached list Permanent registration certificate (Maharashtra Medical Council or Medical Council of India) Medical certificate of physical fitness

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMC Baramati Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form from www.med-edu.in or www.gmcbaramati.org. Fill the form correctly and completely. Attach attested educational, experience and other documents in the order of the attached list. Submit the application and all documents in duplicate. Submit in person or by registered post at the college between 16-11-2026 and 25-11-2026, 11.00 to 05.00 pm, excluding government holidays.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GMC Baramati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMC Baramati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 51 vacancies: 12 Professor, 6 Associate Professor, 33 Assistant Professor (Group B).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GMC Baramati Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.med-edu.in and www.gmcbaramati.org) and send it to Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Government Medical College, Plot P-107, MIDC Area, Opposite Women's Hospital, Baramati 413133, by in person or registered post, to reach by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs.200.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 69 years (at the time of appointment).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs.2,00,000 per month (non-retired candidates) for Professor, Rs.1,85,000 per month (non-retired candidates) for Associate Professor, Rs.1,00,000 per month (non-retired candidates) for Assistant Professor (Group B).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Educational qualification, experience and eligibility as per NMC notification dated 14.02.2022 and 30.06.2025; work experience as per NMC standards; research papers and other eligibility as per Medical Council of India standards. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be a citizen of India and a resident of Maharashtra. Retired teachers of the respective posts and non-retired private or other sector candidates of any age group holding NMC qualification are eligible.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicant exerting direct or indirect pressure on the selection committee will be excluded from the selection process. Candidates absent at the interview will not be considered for contract appointment.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Provisional merit list on 85 marks (Annexure-A items 1 to 4). Document verification and interview. Minimum 41% of 100 marks required for contract appointment. Degree marks (MS/MD/MCh/DNB, MBBS aggregate, XII aggregate): 50 marks.
